prompt-clipboard.name: Prompt Clipboard
prompt-clipboard.tagline: Save, organize, and auto-expand prompts and snippets on any webpage with simple commands
prompt-clipboard.description: A Chrome extension that lets you save, organize, and search prompts and snippets, copy them with one click, or auto-expand them on web pages by typing commands (e.g., /greeting).
features: Organize by categories with fast search
Type /command in any input field to auto-expand
Works on Gmail, Slack, ChatGPT, and any website
howToUse: Open side panel and add prompts
Type /greeting on any webpage to auto-expand
prompt-clipboard.privacy: All data is stored in your browser and never sent to external servers.
prompt-clipboard.supportedLanguages: Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Korean, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese, Indonesian

extension-switch.name: Extension Switch
extension-switch.tagline: Manage installed extensions with groups, toggle ON/OFF, and auto-switch by URL
extension-switch.description: A Chrome extension manager that lets you organize installed extensions into groups, toggle them ON/OFF with one click, and automatically enable/disable them based on the current URL.
howToUse: Toggle ON/OFF by group or individually
extension-switch.privacy: Only extension management data is stored locally in your browser. No external communication.
extension-switch.supportedLanguages: Japanese, English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Arabic, Korean, Thai

tab-window-controller.name: Tab & Window Controller
tab-window-controller.tagline: Open your go-to pages in a split-screen layout and restore your usual workspace with one click
tab-window-controller.description: A Chrome extension that opens multiple pages arranged in a split-screen layout of your choice (2-pane, 3-pane, or 4-pane). Assign an open tab or a URL to each pane and apply — each pane opens as its own window, positioned and sized on screen. Save the combination as a layout and bring your whole workspace back with a single click.
features: Flip left/right (or top/bottom) with the reverse button
Fill each pane from your open tabs, or type a URL directly
Add up to 5 pages per pane (they open as tabs in the same window)
Save up to 5 of your most-used combinations as layouts
Apply a saved layout with one click; reorder by drag and drop
Move a window by hand and its position and size are remembered automatically
Choose the split method: all new windows, or reuse the current window for the first pane
Three font sizes (Medium / Large / Extra Large)
howToUse: Open the popup from the toolbar icon
Choose an open tab for each pane, or enter a URL
Press Apply and the windows open together in the split layout
Save it, and restore the same setup with one click next time
tab-window-controller.privacy: Saved layouts and settings are stored entirely in your own browser and are never sent to any external server. The extension does not access page content.
tab-window-controller.supportedLanguages: 55 languages (Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Korean, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese, Indonesian, and more)
